protocol.policy: The unchanged rule036 reactant/product maps prove one neutral nonisotopic terminal halogen template atom per slot, absent from product and single-bonded to the retained mapped cross-bond endpoint. A tagged raw reverse outcome proves the guide representative has no parent origin; every bounded raw alternative must agree. A source is assessed using ALL complete chiral role embeddings (65th match means unknown), with distinct departure/attachment site pairs retained. Every site is replaced with dummy atomic number0 in an isolated copy, sanitized and all other atom/bond fields checked; any unsafe site, truncation, budget or deadline makes the WHOLE source unknown. Fingerprints are deduplicated by exact canonical projected view. A single fixed maximum projected-source/independently-proven projected-guide Tanimoto is reported as an optimistic score; no site is chosen or injected into a reaction. Both mapped cross-bond endpoint elements must be fixed and equal in the reactant and product template query; ambiguous/broadened or element-changing predicates are unknown. Every projected-view Tanimoto is precharged under a 20-attempt cap and the deadline is rechecked after each score.
